thales.oneLineEn: Water as nature's principle explains diverse change, marking the turn from mythic story to general natural principles.

heraclitus.oneLineEn: Logos governs flux and opposition; the soul must live by a common measure, not private opinion.

parmenides.oneLineEn: From what-is cannot not-be he bars generation and division, parting the way of truth from the way of opinion.

socrates.oneLineEn: Knowledge of ignorance opens elenchus; knowledge of virtue and care of the soul rank above wealth and honor.

epicurus.oneLineEn: Atomism dispels fear of divine will; freedom from pain and mental tranquility define mature pleasure.

zeno-citium.oneLineEn: Cosmic reason is the norm of life; only virtue is good, and assent manages impressions and impulse.

plotinus.oneLineEn: The One's emanation explains levels of Intellect and Soul; contemplation of beauty and virtue guide the soul's return.

hypatia.oneLineEn: Math, astronomy, and public teaching sustained late classical philosophical education amid civic power and violence.

al-farabi.oneLineEn: Cosmic emanation orders the virtuous city; a philosophical ruler coordinates demonstrative truth and religious symbols.

ibn-sina.oneLineEn: Essence-existence distinction is central; the Necessary Existent and the floating man support the soul's independence.

al-ghazali.oneLineEn: Limits philosophical proof and critiques necessary causality; certainty needs purification through spiritual practice.

ibn-rushd.oneLineEn: Defends Aristotle and natural causality; demonstration and law can be coordinated through scriptural interpretation.

mulla-sadra.oneLineEn: Existence is prior and graded; substantial motion and knowledge-as-being join philosophy with spiritual practice.

ibn-khaldun.oneLineEn: Rebuilds historiography via group solidarity and civilizational conditions, tracking dynasties from cohesion to decline.

augustine.oneLineEn: Evil as privation from will's turning away; grace renews and two loves of two cities order history.

boethius.oneLineEn: Fortune's wheel dissolves the illusion of outer happiness; the eternal present reconciles providence with free choice.

anselm.oneLineEn: Faith seeking understanding yields the ontological argument and joins justice and mercy through satisfaction theory.
keywordsEn: That than which nothing greater can be thought

aquinas.oneLineEn: Natural reason's five ways lead to God; essence-existence distinction and natural law constrain politics and law.

ockham.oneLineEn: Nominalism rejects universal substances; divine absolute power loosens necessity and bounds fallible church authority.

saadia-gaon.oneLineEn: Rational argument upholds revealed faith; creation doctrine and commandment practice strengthen communal certainty.

maimonides.oneLineEn: Negative theology constrains speech about God; law serves both intellectual perfection and political order.

buber.oneLineEn: I-Thou direct relation defines real existence; dialogue and community precede objectifying I-It life.

levinas.oneLineEn: The face of the Other precedes totalizing knowledge; infinite responsibility starts language and ethics.
